summary: One-shot replay status UI renderer. If replay recording is active (this+0x0 == 1) and the message has not yet been displayed (this+0x4 == 0), it renders a 'ReplayRecording' line via TextLineWrappingAndRendering, then, unless a session-state check fails, builds a longer 'ReplayActivati...' message (seeding a local buffer from byte_5EA438, appending word_5C32D8 and a module path from sub_455260) and renders that on a second line. Sets this+0x4 = 1 to prevent re-display.

operations.description: Guard: if this+0x4 (already-displayed flag) is nonzero, or this+0x0 is not 1 (replay recording active), the entire body is skipped and the current value of this+0x4 is returned.
BinarySearchInStringTable(byte_5EC4C0, aReplayRecordin, byte_5EC4CC) looks up the 'ReplayRecording' string and, when found, copies it into byte_5EC4CC (message display buffer).
TextLineWrappingAndRendering(&dword_7CD204, byte_5EC4CC, 2, 16909060) renders the replay-recording status message.
result = SessionStateCheckWrapper(dword_7CD25C); a nonzero result skips the activation-message block below.
Seed local message buffer v11 with byte_5EA438[0] (directory/path prefix) and zero-initialize the remaining 0x4C bytes plus v12/v13.
BinarySearchInStringTable(byte_5EC4C0, aReplayActivati, byte_5EC4CC) looks up the 'ReplayActivati' string and, when found, copies it into byte_5EC4CC.
Copy the activation string from byte_5EC4CC into the local message buffer v11 (strcpy-style loop terminating on the null byte).
Append word_5C32D8 as a trailing WORD immediately after v11's terminating null (v11[strlen(v11)]), fusing a stored 16-bit value onto the message buffer.
v9 = sub_455260(dword_7D1D8C) retrieves a module path string (held in v10); a null result means no path is available.
If the module path is non-null: BinarySearchInStringTable(byte_5EC4C0, v9, byte_5EC4CC) copies the path into byte_5EC4CC, then strcat(v11, byte_5EC4CC) appends it to the local message buffer.
result = TextLineWrappingAndRendering(&dword_7CD204, v11, 3, 16909060) renders the full replay-activation message on a second line.
this+0x4 = 1 marks the message as displayed so subsequent calls return early via the guard.
Return result — this+0x4 when the guard skipped the body, otherwise the last render/session-check result.
